title: Short Nepal Tour Package - 3 days
highlights: Scenic flight from Kathmandu to Lukla—one of the world’s most thrilling airports
Trek through Sagarmatha National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Explore Namche Bazaar, the gateway to Everest
Visit Tengboche Monastery, the largest and most spiritual in the region
Enjoy panoramic views of Everest, Lhotse, Ama Dablam, and more from multiple viewpoints
Experience high-altitude trekking and witness the stunning Khumbu Glacier
Reach Everest Base Camp (5,364 m)—the starting point for Everest expeditions

overview: Experience the cultural and spiritual wonders of Nepal with Green Sky Travels. This carefully curated 2-3 day itinerary takes you through the historic and sacred landmarks of Kathmandu, including UNESCO World Heritage Sites like Swayambhunath Stupa, Patan Durbar Square, Pashupatinath Temple, and Boudhanath. Enjoy breathtaking sunrise views over the Himalayas from Nagarkot and explore the ancient city of Bhaktapur. With expert guides, comfortable accommodations, and seamless travel arrangements, this tour promises an enriching and unforgettable experience. Book now with Green Sky Travels and immerse yourself in the essence of Nepal.

Enjoy an unforgettable journey to the heart of Nepal with our "Short Nepal Tour Package." This itinerary is designed to give you a deep cultural and spiritual experience while exploring the iconic UNESCO World Heritage Sites of Kathmandu and its surrounding areas.

sections.title: Why Visit Kathmandu?
paragraphs: Kathmandu, the capital of Nepal, is a city steeped in history, culture, and spirituality. Known as the "City of Temples," it boasts a blend of Hindu and Buddhist traditions, reflected in its exquisite palaces, stupas, and courtyards. Whether you seek adventure, cultural immersion, or spiritual enlightenment, Kathmandu offers a unique and fulfilling experience.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu Nepal and Hotel Transfers
itinerary.description: Upon your arrival, we shall welcome you at the airport with your name card and a traditional khada to greet you in Nepali style. Then we will escort you to your hotel. You can take a rest at your hotel or, if you prefer, explore the surroundings on your own. If time and interest allow, you may walk around the local markets and experience the city's atmosphere. In the evening, we will host a pre-trip meeting at your hotel, where you will meet your tour guide. The guide will provide a detailed briefing about the tour and share the plan for the next day. Enjoy your evening in Kathmandu at your leisure.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing in Kathmandu UNESCO World Heritage Sites
itinerary.description: After a delightful breakfast at the hotel, embark on a full-day sightseeing tour covering Kathmandu’s most significant cultural and historical landmarks:

highlights.title: Swayambhunath Stupa (Monkey Temple)
highlights.description: An ancient Buddhist stupa offering panoramic views of Kathmandu Valley.

highlights.title: Patan Durbar Square
highlights.description: It is a historical palace square renowned for its exquisite architecture and traditional craftsmanship.

highlights.title: Pashupatinath Temple
highlights.description: A sacred Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, located along the banks of the Bagmati River.

highlights.title: Boudhanath Stupa
highlights.description: One of the largest Buddhist stupas in the world, a major pilgrimage site for Tibetan Buddhists.

itinerary.ending: After an enriching day of exploration, return to the hotel for an overnight stay in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Trek from Phakding to Namche Bazaar (3440m)
itinerary.description: Early in the morning, drive to Nagarkot, a scenic hilltop destination known for its breathtaking sunrise views over the Himalayan range. After enjoying the mesmerizing sunrise, proceed to Bhaktapur Durbar Square, an ancient city filled with centuries-old temples, courtyards, and vibrant local culture.In the afternoon or evening, depending on your flight schedule, we will transfer you to the airport for your departure, marking the end of your incredible Kathmandu journey. Have a wonderful journey ahead. We look forward to welcome you back in near future for next holiday.

goodToKnow: Local Currency: Nepalese Rupee (NPR); ATMs are available in Kathmandu but limited in trekking areas.
Wi-Fi & Electricity: Internet and charging are available in lodges for a small fee. Solar power is commonly used at higher altitudes.
Drinking Water: Bottled water is available, but using water purification tablets or refilling at teahouses is recommended.
Emergency Services: Helicopter evacuation is available in case of emergencies but requires travel insurance that covers high-altitude evacuation.
Cultural Etiquette: Respect local customs, dress modestly in monasteries, and avoid touching prayer flags or religious objects without permission.
Trekking Permits: Our team will arrange all necessary permits before the trek begins.
